courses.name: BS Civil Engineering
courses.tagline: Design and build roads, bridges, buildings and water systems.
courses.licensure: Civil Engineer licensure exam (PRC)

courses.name: BS Electrical Engineering
courses.tagline: Power systems, wiring and electrical design for homes, factories and cities.
courses.licensure: Registered Electrical Engineer exam (PRC)

courses.name: BS Mechanical Engineering
courses.tagline: Engines, machines, manufacturing and the systems that keep things moving.
courses.licensure: Mechanical Engineer exam (PRC)

courses.name: BS Electronics and Communications Engineering
courses.tagline: Circuits, signals, telecommunications and the technology behind phones and the internet.
courses.licensure: Electronics Engineer / ECE exam (PRC)

courses.name: BS Computer Engineering
courses.tagline: Where hardware meets software: embedded systems, robotics and computer design.
courses.licensure: Computer Engineer licensure exam (PRC) - verify current status

courses.name: BS Computer Science
courses.tagline: Software, algorithms, data and artificial intelligence.
courses.licensure: No mandatory licensure exam; optional industry certifications

courses.name: BS Human Services
courses.tagline: Support individuals, families and communities through social programs.
courses.licensure: Verify requirements with URS; not the same as the Social Worker licensure track

courses.name: BS Psychology
courses.tagline: Study the mind and behavior through research and real-life application.
careers: Guidance or counseling aide (graduate study for higher roles)

courses.tagline: Study animals, their behavior, ecosystems and conservation.
